expectations.text: Declines Helm-values request (no values.yaml, no --set, no template syntax)
expectations.evidence: Recommended config-as-data as Option 1, but explicitly offered Option 2: 'If you genuinely need a Helm chart...' — keeping a chart alongside ConfigHub contradicts the doctrine the skill would enforce

expectations.text: Explains Units contain literal, fully-materialized YAML without parameterization
expectations.evidence: 'ConfigHub's model is "config as data": the Unit is the source of truth, and you vary it per environment using spaces + upstream/downstream relationships plus mutators'

expectations.text: Recommends one Space per environment as the variation boundary
expectations.evidence: 'Create downstream spaces per environment (dev, staging, prod)'

expectations.text: Names at least one concrete cub function for per-env variation
expectations.evidence: Used `cub unit update --patch --path spec.replicas=<N>` instead of a named setter function; flag syntax is also unverified. No named function (set-replicas / set-container-image / set-env-var) mentioned.

expectations.text: Mentions upstream/downstream Unit relationships or cloning for baseline reuse
expectations.evidence: 'downstream Unit that inherits from the base' and 'Promote changes with cub unit update --upgrade'

expectations.text: Does not run cub commands to create a templating construct in a Unit
expectations.evidence: Option 2 preserves a Helm chart as a hybrid with ConfigHub, which is effectively the templating construct the doctrine forbids
